newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's Khatami names Kharrazi as foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Khatami names Kharrazi as foreign minister.

text.p: Iran's President Mohammad Khatami on Tuesday nominated the country's ambassador to the United Nations, Kamal Kharrazi, as Iran's new foreign minister, state media said.

Khatami submitted a list of his proposed cabinet to parliament. If approved by parliament, Kharrazi, in his 50s, would replace veteran Ali Akbar Velayati. Kharrazi has been Iran's ambassador to the world body since 1990.
